verdict.rationale: Vapi's Composer lets users "describe what you want to build" and handles setup from that description. The official MCP server also exposes Vapi APIs as tools, so users can manage assistants, phone numbers, and calls in natural language from Claude Desktop or other MCP clients. missing for 10: in-depth Composer documentation (only a single-line mention), clarity on which operations Composer covers beyond initial setup, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
